children: US transportation provider's Q3 revenue rose 20%, beating analyst expectations
Q3 EPS of $1.82 misses consensus of $1.89 as operating margin narrows to 6.7% from 7.9%
Net income for Q3 missed analyst expectations
Company expects 2026 full-year tax rate to be about 24%
SEGMENT PERFORMANCE - Higher Intermodal loads, increased ICS and Truckload revenue per load drove revenue growth, partially offset by lower Final Mile Services stops
PRODUCTIVITY AND COSTS - Improved productivity and lower storage costs supported operating income, but higher transportation, personnel, equipment and insurance expenses offset gains
MARGIN PRESSURE - Operating margin declined due to higher purchased transportation, fuel, and insurance claims costs
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 15 "strong buy" or "buy", 9 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the ground freight & logistics peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc. is $290.00, about 24.9% above its October 14 closing price of $232.16
The stock recently traded at 25 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 35 three months ago
